event.description: AT-URI of the parent app.zeens.event record.

viewer.description: Viewer DID, used to report viewer.like per comment.

main.description: List comments on an event via app.zeens.eventComment, newest-first by createdAt. Returns a flat list (each carrying its optional parent ref) so the client can thread organiser replies. Each comment is hydrated with the author's profile and its own like_count + the viewer's like state.
